basis: The choropleth map visually encodes incidence values using a color gradient from light yellow (Low) to dark red (High). The caption explicitly states 'darker color means higher true value'. California (CA) is the only state colored with the darkest shade (dark red), corresponding to the highest incidence value (100 on the scale). Tennessee (TN) is the lightest (yellow), indicating the lowest incidence. Delaware (DE) is a medium shade, indicating a moderate incidence. The task requires routing the state with the highest incidence.
option_label: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up
